newsitem.title: USA: Mercantile Bancorp Q4 net rises after acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Mercantile Bancorp Q4 net rises after acquisition.

text.p: Mercantile Bancorporation Inc on Wednesday said its fourth-quarter earnings increased in part because of its expansion through an acquisition.

The company's net income rose to $66.6 million in the quarter from $56.6 million in the year-ago period, thanks to several one-time events. They included the fourth-quarter acquisition of Today's Bancorp Inc and the completion of the sale of its indentured trustee and agency business, the company said.
The bank holding company also signed agreements to merge with Mark Twain Bancshares Inc and Roosevelt Financial Group Inc in the period.
Its shares closed up 1/4 at 51-3/8 in Nasdaq trading.
